summary: Manchester United plc filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated September 9, 2026, announcing the date for its fourth quarter and full fiscal year 2026 earnings release. The company will report results for the period ended June 30, 2026 on September 23, 2026 at 7:00 AM EST. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, activist campaign, or other special-situation event is disclosed. The filing contains no deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics, making it an ordinary scheduling announcement.
